patches_added.name: Easy deeplinks configuration
patches_added.description: Allows easy configuration of deeplinks (velov.cyclocity.fr, velov.grandlyon.com) required by the app to sign-in

patches_added.name: Rename shared permissions
patches_added.description: Rename certain permissions shared across Amazon apps. Applying this patch can fix installation errors, but can also break features in certain apps.

patches_added.name: Hide Facebook buttons
patches_added.description: Hides buttons and shortcuts that open Facebook.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox stories and notes tray
patches_added.description: Hides the stories and notes horizontal tray at the top of the inbox.

patches_added.name: Open links externally
patches_added.description: Always opens links in your default browser instead of the in-app browser, regardless of the in-app setting.

patches_added.name: Spoof package version
patches_added.description: Sets a very high version code so the Play Store treats the app as already up to date and never offers an update.

patches_removed.name: Hide Facebook button
patches_removed.description: Hides the Facebook button in the top toolbar.

patches_added.name: Force system font (including monospace) (GitHub)
patches_added.description: Renders GitHub UI and monospace text using the device system UI font.

patches_modified.name: Force system font (Bitwarden)
patches_modified.description: Renders the app using the device's system font instead of DM Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches_modified.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network.
